Record unknown reasoning variants and measurement dates as limitations; they do not by themselves erase model-level support. An observed unmet task requirement or unresolved relevant conflict prevents positive support. This judges an evidence-supported option, not future delivery success or a reliability certificate. Do not infer capability from names, add indices to the answer, or judge speed or price.

criteria.false: Neither usable task-related catalog support nor exact sourced quality support is supplied, relevant sources conflict, or an observed capability cannot meet the task. Missing exact route evidence alone does not establish this outcome.

Do not use speed, latency, elapsed time, tokens per second or price. Member availability is enforced separately, so unknown availability does not lower this probability.
